senses.gloss:
ITA-5.56.1.1 bhagandaraḥ भगन्दरः
Anal fistula
Fistula of the ano-rectal region. An anorectal abscess formed due to vitiated dosha or trauma, results in an abnormal tract or tunnel (fistula) which breaks through the perineum, anus and/or bladder regions, and discharges pus. This results in a chronic nonhealing fistula.

ITA-5.56.1.2 bhagandarapūrvarūpam भगन्दरपूर्वरूपम्
Prodromal symptoms of anal fistula
The early stage of bhagandaraḥ is characterized by pain at iliac region/iliac bones; itching; burning sensation; anal oedema; nodule leading to fistula-in-ano; burning sensation; pain.

ITA-5.55.1 bhagnaḥ भग्नः
Fracture
A condition characterized by marked swelling; inability to bear movement or rotation and touch; crepitus on squeezing; looseness of parts; appearance of various types of pain; no relief of pain in any posture

ITA-6.2.6.79 bhagnasandhānam, bhagnasandhānakaraḥ भग्नसन्धानम्, भग्नसन्धानकरः
Substance aiding in union of fractures
